plugins.name: motta-statusline
plugins.description: Two-line status line: folder, repo link, git state, the branch's PR with CI, conflicts and review (toasts when they change), model and effort, a context bar with the auto-compact point, rate limits, a prompt-cache countdown, tokens and the generation rate. Under the prompt in the CLI, or as a band above it.

plugins.name: assumption-check
plugins.description: A side pane of the assumptions Claude makes, one dropdown per prompt, with counts that filter: mark one right, or wrong (type the fix or let Claude ask), ask why, open its source, or delete it. On from the start, /assumption-check off to stop; nothing in the pane reaches Claude unless you press wrong or why.

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: A ✦ enhance chip above the prompt, or /enhance <text>, that opens an Enhance pane and rewrites your draft one of two ways, in one model call: Cleaned up (a cheap model fixes typos, fillers, voice-to-text artifacts and punctuation, nothing else) or Expanded (a short, clear prompt written with the conversation). Use it, send it or copy it; the band holds the chip alone.

plugins.name: cache-warmer
plugins.description: One button under ✦ enhance: 🔥 with keep-warm on, ❄ with it off, beside how long the prompt cache stays warm and the pings sent. While on and you are away it re-reads the cache with a one-word fork a few minutes before it expires, so your next prompt is not billed the whole conversation again. Off until you press it; stops 4 idle hours after your last turn.

plugins.name: emotive-spinner
plugins.description: The spinner line says what Claude is doing instead of a whimsical word: a symbol and plain words for the file it reads or writes (with its size, lines so far while it streams), the command it runs in its own description, the search, the page, the agents and what the latest is doing, thinking, writing the answer, or waiting for you. Read from the engine's events; no model calls. Terminal and desktop app.

plugins.name: tool-borders
plugins.description: Marks each tool call with a color: the hue says what it does (read, change, delegate, run, bookkeeping) and the shade how far it reaches (project, elsewhere on this machine, internet). A border in the CLI, a thin bar on the desktop app.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: IDE-style file tree with git status that shimmers on files Claude reads and writes, and lists those outside its folder. Vendored from data-goblin/claude-code-filetree@bf8de32 (MIT).

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Live agents panel (/agents-info) with each subagent's model, context, cost and time. Vendored from JohnnyVizz/claude-kit@272a877 (MIT).
